title: Aurum Alpha problem+json error envelope
description: The RFC 9457 problem details envelope, profiled. Governed by standards/050-http.md HA2. Every error response from every endpoint uses this shape, served as application/problem+json. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

type.description: A stable URI identifying the error CLASS — clients branch on this, so changing what one means is a breaking change and gets a new type rather than an edit (HA2). Portfolio form: https://errors.aurumalpha.dev/<service>/<slug>. RFC 9457 does not require it to resolve; the form is pinned so it can become dereferenceable later without changing a client. 'about:blank' only where the status code is the whole story.

title.description: Human-readable name of the class, identical for every instance of this type so that errors group.

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body so a logged or forwarded envelope stays complete on its own.

detail.description: THIS occurrence's specific reason, per the reason-giving rule of 030-service.md SC2: which value, which rule, which limit. Never the bare class restated, never a stack trace, never a secret or a record's contents — this envelope crosses the trust boundary.

instance.description: A URI for this specific occurrence, typically the request path.

errors.description: One entry per rejected field, on validation failures (HA2). A client highlighting three bad inputs cannot do it from prose.

field.description: The rejected field, named as the request body spells it.

rule.description: The constraint violated, as a stable slug a client can branch on: 'required', 'format', 'max_length', 'not_in_future'.

message.description: Human-readable specifics. Names the field and what was wrong with it — never echoes a secret or protected personal value back.
